name: @pipeworx/mcp-riksdagen-se

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search Riksdagen documents (motions, propositions, committee reports, written questions). Filter by free-text query, document type, and date range. Results nest under dokumentlista.dokument[].

doktyp.description: Document type code: mot=motion, prop=government proposition, bet=committee report, fr=written question, frs=answer, ip=interpellation, SFS=statute, prot=protocol.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List current members of the Riksdag (ledamöter), optionally filtered by party and/or constituency. Results nest under personlista.person[] with Swedish fields (parti, valkrets, efternamn, tilltalsnamn).

parti.description: Party abbreviation, e.g. S, M, SD, C, V, KD, L, MP.

tools.name: list_votes
tools.description: List individual member votes (voteringar) for a parliamentary session and committee-report designation. Results nest under voteringlista.votering[]; each row has namn, parti, valkrets and rost (Ja/Nej/Avstår/Frånvarande).

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Fetch a single document's full metadata by its id (e.g. "HD024189" or "hd024189"). Result nests under dokumentstatus.dokument.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-riksdagen-se forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the riksdagen-se pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
